source_scope: Selected complete-panel scores, plan and evidence references. Raw internal traces and model weights are not bundled. This was fixed locally before execution and published after completion, not a public preregistration.
question: For the working one-step answer writer, are its induced attention/MoE updates in blocks20-23 necessary for the supplied-label ranking, and can those recorded updates transmit that ranking without the original writer displacement?

panel.exposure: All contexts/worlds were already development-exposed; the96cells are not96 independent language tasks.

arms.B: Uniform writer probabilities; native later updates.
arms.W: Actual frozen reader, energy module and writer; native later updates.
arms.S0: Uniform writer; replay same-cell B branch outputs. Exact baseline sham.
arms.D: Exact same-cell W probabilities; replay same-cell B branch outputs.
arms.T: Uniform writer; replay same-cell W branch outputs, originally generated with W writer displacement.
arms.S1: Exact same-cell W probabilities; replay same-cell W branch outputs. Exact written sham.

intervention: Replace only the final-position first returned tensor of self_attn and block_sparse_moe in blocks20,21,22,23. Preserve other positions and tuple members. Leave all native residual additions, residual_multiplier, norms, lm_head and logits_scaling intact. Replay is from the identical context/world B or W call; the native branches still physically execute.
findings: Both D and T preserved all96 unique correct choices. No W choice was lost in either condition.
Under the D clamp, writer-dependent changes in the eight branch outputs were unnecessary for these categorical decisions; native residual additions, final normalization and output head remained.

T demonstrates sufficiency of recorded written updates when replayed with a uniform writer. Those donor updates were originally produced using the real writer displacement. This is not evidence of independently operating redundant modules.
The mean target-versus-best-other score margin was10.0078125 for W,3.6959635416666665 for D and5.805989583333333 for T. These are uncalibrated score margins, not confidence probabilities.
Both-arm survival does not confirm the full illustrative direct-code-only prediction in the critique, which also suggested that T would fail most choices.
limits: All96 exposed cells over24 language contexts and four known worlds; no independent population sample or new-world generalization.
Scores are eight-candidate rankings; no generated-answer competence, planning, energy advantage or novelty claim.
Fixed margins use registered requested-world targets. Only after full replication do these equal unique supplied probability targets.
D/T are controlled hybrid branch replays. Native norms/head/residual arithmetic remain; tail writes themselves may encode the answer.
Finite margin contrasts describe interventions and their interaction; no additive mechanism, natural mediation, p-value or normalized causal fraction is inferred.
The raw audit is separate code. Frozen reader/energy/writer numerical cores are reused; writer-core authorship overlaps this auditor.
Native host attention/MoE/norm/head are not independently reexecuted. Captured BF16 multiply/add chains and replay byte identities are checked exactly.
Resource maxima are sampled, not continuous peak guarantees. Original owner remains responsible for closure and final monitor/log hashes.

source_bundle.purpose: Inspect the frozen collector, tests, numerical checkers and plan. The bundle omits raw data, trained artifacts and pretrained model files required for a full rerun.

next_question.question: Can an organ provide only partial state that the host uses according to its own context, rather than carrying a complete answer?
next_question.candidate: A fixed number-state message that affects verb agreement when attached to the subject but preserves an independently varied subject when attached to an intervening noun.
next_question.limitation: Grammar steering and causal interchange already have prior art; this is a candidate test, not a novelty claim or an admitted interface.
